title: Development and Validation of an Internet-based Near and Intermediate-vision Reading Test
brief_summary: Primary objective of our study is to develop and validate an internet-based digital near and intermediate-vision reading test in the greek language.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adequate literacy of written Greek language
* Age between 18 to 75 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* Dyslexia
* Attention-deficiency
* Former diagnosis of mental and/or psychiatric diseases
study_population: Normal- and low-sighted participants aged 18 to 75 years
